name: Xikar Xi2 Cutter — Matte Black
description: Xikar's Xi2 is the cutter against which all others are measured. The double-blade guillotine design uses stainless steel blades hardened to 56 HRC — they cut cleanly through a 54-ring gauge cigar in a single motion without crushing the wrapper. Xikar backs every cutter with a lifetime guarantee, no questions asked. The matte black finish wears well and shows no fingerprints.

name: Colibri S-Cut Punch Cutter
description: A punch cutter removes a small circular section from the cap rather than cutting across the full head — the result is a more concentrated draw that some smokers prefer, particularly on larger ring gauges. Colibri's version has a spring-loaded blade and a satisfying click when the punch retracts. Fits on a keyring. Indispensable as a backup.

name: Prometheus Magnus III Triple-Flame Torch
description: Three jet flames arranged in a triangle pattern toast the foot of a cigar evenly without hot spots — essential for a Robusto or Churchill that deserves a proper light. The Magnus III has a fuel window so you can see the butane level, a reliable piezo ignition, and a punch cutter built into the base. Prometheus fill this at their factory before shipping; it arrives ready to use.

name: Quality Importers Desktop Humidor — 50 Cigar
description: A solid entry-level desktop humidor in mahogany-finish wood with a Spanish cedar lining — the cedar regulates humidity naturally and imparts a subtle complementary note to the cigars stored inside. Holds approximately 50 cigars. Includes an analogue hygrometer and a foam humidifier element. Season the cedar before first use by wiping the interior with distilled water and leaving for 24 hours.

name: Xikar Crystal Humidifier Jar
description: Xikar's crystal humidifier uses propylene glycol solution absorbed into silica crystals to maintain a steady 70% relative humidity — the standard storage level for most premium cigars. The crystals are visible through the glass jar; when they appear dry and shrunken, add distilled water. Refills are needed every 2–3 months depending on humidor size and how often you open it.

name: Visol Welded Stainless Ashtray
description: Heavy-gauge welded stainless steel, brushed finish, with two deep cigar rests machined to accommodate up to a 60-ring gauge. The weight — just over a kilogram — means it stays where you put it, even outdoors in a light breeze. The wide ash basin is deep enough for a full Churchill without overflow. Dishwasher safe.

name: Boveda 69% Humidity Packs — 8g (10-pack)
description: Boveda's two-way humidity control packs are the easiest way to maintain a humidor correctly. Unlike foam humidifiers, they both add and absorb moisture to maintain a precise level — place them in the humidor and stop thinking about it. The 8g size is for travel cases and smaller desktop humidors up to 25 cigars. Replace when the pack feels fully rigid and no longer flexible.
